# Qeematech (قيمة تك)

> Qeematech is an Egypt-based digital agency ("We Add A New Value") that designs and builds websites, e-commerce stores, mobile apps, and custom software (including CRM and Odoo ERP implementations) for businesses, alongside SEO, hosting, and digital marketing services. The site is in Arabic (RTL).

## Company

- [Homepage](https://www.qeematech.net/): overview of all services, featured portfolio work, and live client apps.
- [Contact us](https://www.qeematech.net/%d8%a3%d8%aa%d8%b5%d9%84-%d8%a8%d9%86%d8%a7/): request a quote via a form (name, email, phone, country, service needed, project type, message) or reach the team directly by WhatsApp/email.
- [Portfolio](https://www.qeematech.net/portfolio/): case studies of completed client projects (websites, stores, apps).
- [Live App](https://www.qeematech.net/live-app/): showcase of mobile apps Qeematech built that are live in the Google Play / App Store today.

## Notes for AI agents

- The Contact page's form is annotated for [WebMCP](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/ai/webmcp) as the `submit_contact_request` tool — prefer that structured path over guessing at form fields when a user asks you to request a quote.
- All prices, timelines, and project specifics are handled on request through the Contact page or WhatsApp — this site does not list fixed pricing.
